email.body1:
Jackie, saw Nextech launched Cora Scribe and expanded the Payments platform with Stripe and Affirm this spring.

When the product set grows that fast, the practices worth pursuing usually outpace what inside sales can work before interest cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without adding reps: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jackie, quick follow-up for Nextech.

With Cora and the new payment features in market, quota usually climbs faster than the inside team can cover. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nextech needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jackie, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nextech's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Jackie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an inside sales motion? I will tailor it to Nextech either way.
